LESSON: MASS, VOLUME, WEIGHT AND DENSITY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: MEASUREMENTS
Topic 3.3: Mass, Volume, Weight and Density
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Mass, Volume, Weight and Density, part of MEASUREMENTS in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How do you weigh materials and objects?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Mass, Volume, Weight and Density together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Signing, observing and writing; As the learner engage in group discussion using facts and

examples to support points when they are discussing the relationship between mass and weight.

● Learning to learn: Knows what doing well looks like; A learner organises their own learning as they collect and weigh different

materials or objects and change one unit of mass to another.

Values:
● Integrity: A learner enhances discipline as they give correct mass and weights of different material and objects.

● Responsibility: A learner enhances diligence as they work and take care of weighing machines and other resources.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Life Skills and Human Sexuality: Self-awareness; A learner weighs themselves for health purposes.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of weights and measures to concepts of measuring chemicals and ingredients in Agriculture

and Nutrition.
